headline: Chiefs reach the ten yard line
what_happened: P.Mahomes completed a short pass to R.Rice for six yards, but the team did not gain enough yards for a first down.
who: P.Mahomes threw the ball to R.Rice.
why_it_matters: Since they did not reach the first down marker, this is neutral for the Chiefs' winning chances. They are now very close to the end zone, which is a great spot to be in.
